headline: Built-environment demand is recovering unevenly (civil engineering and data centres lead, buildings lag) while construction-tech venture money is flowing into AI and the EU calls for 2027 are lining up around renovation robotics, LCA and water resilience.
outlook_reason: Finnish and EU construction output recovered in 2025, Finnish permits are rising, large AI construction rounds continued into autumn 2026, and EPBD-driven renovation and carbon rules create demand, although residential building is still weak.

metrics.label: EU27 construction of buildings vs civil engineering
Horizon call budget: on-site robotics for renovation
Horizon NEB call budget: thermal comfort in buildings

signals.title: Shackleton exits stealth with $5M seed
signals.detail: AI construction startup Shackleton launched an agentic operating system for construction with a $5M seed led by Battery Ventures. I only have a search summary of this, not the primary article.

signals.title: Horizon AI, Data and Robotics partnership call opens
signals.detail: Call HORIZON-CL4-2024-DIGITAL-EMERGING-01-04 opened on 2026-11-04 with a deadline of 2027-01-27. It is a general AI and robotics call that could fit construction robotics and data. Fit with the sector has not been checked in detail.

signals.title: Miter raises $40M
signals.detail: Miter, an AI workforce platform for construction, raised $40M in a round led by Battery Ventures. The round was reported by Webull and Pulse, and the series label is uncertain.

signals.title: Buildots raises $130M
signals.detail: The Israeli-founded AI site-monitoring company raised $130M to expand into data centres and industrial facilities. This shows that late-stage capital is available and that data centres are a key vertical.

signals.title: Finnish EPBD implementation behind schedule
signals.detail: The Confederation of Finnish Construction Industries (RT) says stricter energy-efficiency requirements are coming but the schedule is late. The 29 May 2026 deadline was missed, and the rules are split across several laws and decrees. I found no news from autumn 2026 confirming that the laws have entered into force.

signals.title: Aalto ranked third in Europe for spin-out funding
signals.detail: An Aalto news item (Swedish version) says Aalto ranked third among European universities for spin-out funding, behind Oxford and Cambridge, in the first half of 2026. I could not confirm the exact wording or date from the translated page.
